本書は、CHUCKのWeb画面でHF回線を設定し、24時間の伝搬、回線マップ、報: This manual explains how to use the CHUCK web screen to set up an HF link and check the 24-hour propagation, the link map, reports, area coverage, multiple RX sites, the station mesh, the 12-month forecast, the required transmit power and site candidates. Start with a calculation between fixed stations, then set up mobile stations, external observations and AI import of antenna documents as needed.

The manual is now distributed as PDF only. This edition covers the time slider and frequency row selection on heatmaps, the link map shown for the selected frequency, and the two-way paths of the mesh forecast.

画面右上の「新機能のお知らせ」の左に、操作要領のダウンロードボタンがあります。: The manual download button is at the top right of the screen, to the left of “What’s new”.

保存先はブラウザのダウンロード設定に従います。: Where the file is saved depends on your browser’s download settings.

Docker Desktopを起動し、ターミナルをリポジトリのフォルダーで開きま: Start Docker Desktop and open a terminal in the repository folder. No AI API key is needed for normal propagation calculations. If you use the public version (a website that needs no installation), you can skip this chapter.
初回ビルドにはベースイメージ等の取得用インターネット接続が必要です。ビルド後は、: The first build needs an internet connection to fetch the base images and other components. After the build, calculations with a manual SSN and the map display work offline. On Mac/Linux you can also start with sh Start.sh, and in Windows PowerShell with ./Start.ps1.
ログ表示はCtrl+Cで終了します。この操作だけではコンテナは停止しません。: Press Ctrl+C to leave the log display. This alone does not stop the containers.
計算履歴、地点・アンテナ、取込原本、AI保存設定、定時の再計算はhf-data、: The calculation history, locations and antennas, imported source documents, saved AI settings and scheduled recalculations are stored in hf-data, and the station settings and latest positions in gateway-data. They are kept across normal stops and rebuilds. docker compose down -v deletes both persistent volumes, so do not use it for a normal shutdown.

RXを増やす場合は「＋ RXを追加」を押します。RXが2局以上ならダイバーシティ: To add RX, press “＋ Add RX”. With two or more RX, the calculation becomes a diversity forecast.
不要なRXは「RXを削除」で削除します。最後の1局は削除できません。: Remove an RX you do not need with “Remove RX”. The last one cannot be removed.
座標を新規登録する場合は「地点を登録・編集」、アンテナを編集する場合は「アンテナ: To register new coordinates, open “Register / edit locations”; to edit antennas, open “Register / edit antennas”. Antennas marked as reference only cannot be selected for calculations.
「予測条件・宇宙天気」タブを開きます。画面例では2026年11月、SSN 100: Open the “Forecast & space weather” tab. The example screen uses November 2026, SSN 100 (manual input) and 10 frequencies from 2 to 20 MHz.
予測する年月を選択。時刻別結果はUTCです。: Select the year and month to forecast. Hourly results are in UTC.
NOAA（対象月の平滑SSNを計算時に取得し0.7倍して使用）、手動入力（0～2: Choose NOAA (the smoothed SSN for the month is fetched at calculation time and multiplied by 0.7), manual input (0 to 250) or effective SSN (calculated for the current month from observed foF2).
2～30 MHzから最大11個。カンマまたは空白で区切ります。: Up to 11 values from 2 to 30 MHz, separated by commas or spaces.
最低打上げ角、要求SNR、吸収モードを確認します。: Check the minimum take-off angle, required SNR and absorption mode.
目標RELと4段階表示の境界（第7章）。: The target REL and the boundaries of the 4-grade display (Chapter 7).
詳細条件（最低打上げ角・要求SNR・吸収モード）: Advanced conditions (minimum take-off angle, required SNR, absorption mode)
最初は「SSN取得方法」を手動入力にして、条件を確認します。: To start, set “SSN source” to manual input and check the conditions.
今月の回線を詰めるときは実効SSN、来月以降の計画や12か月予測にはNOAAを使: Use effective SSN when refining links for the current month, and NOAA for planning next month or later and for the 12-month forecast. With NOAA, 0.7 times the published value is used in the calculation, and the results record both the published and the converted value.
「詳細条件」の吸収モードは既定a（VOACAP Online Marineと同じ: The absorption mode under “Advanced conditions” defaults to a (the same as VOACAP Online Marine). The previous values can be reproduced with W.

電波型式・受信品質と偏波方式: Emission class, reception quality and polarization
電波型式（A1A、J3E、A3E、F1B、G1D等）を選びます。A1A 19、J: Choose the emission class (A1A, J3E, A3E, F1B, G1D and so on). The required SNR values of 19 for A1A, 39 for J3E and 48 dB·Hz for A3E are examples (the same as VOACAP Online Marine). Change them as needed.
占有帯域幅を電波型式の表記（3K00、2K40、500H等）で入力します。: Enter the occupied bandwidth in emission designator notation (3K00, 2K40, 500H and so on).
帯域内SNRから入力する場合は「帯域内SNRと占有帯域幅から換算」を選び、必要S: To enter the in-band SNR, choose “Convert in-band SNR and occupied bandwidth” and specify the required SNR. Example: 3K00 and 10 dB convert to about 44.77 dB·Hz.
FSK・PSK等はモデム、符号化、速度、目標BERに合う要求SNRを指定します。: For FSK, PSK and similar modes, specify the required SNR that matches the modem, coding, speed and target BER.
偏波方式をTXと各RXで選び、必要なら全経路共通の追加偏波損失（0～30 dB）: Choose the polarization for TX and each RX, and if needed specify an additional polarization loss common to all paths (0 to 30 dB).
偏波名は条件として記録します。名前の変更だけではアンテナパターンを切り替えず、偏: The polarization name is recorded as a condition. Changing the name alone does not switch the antenna pattern, and polarization mismatch and Faraday rotation are not calculated automatically. The additional loss is applied as an equivalent power reduction. Do not count losses twice that are already included in the antenna gain or cable loss. Demodulation of waveforms, delay spread and the BER itself are not calculated.
目標RELとREL表示の閾値: Target REL and REL display thresholds
「REL表示の閾値」で、合否の基準になる目標RELと、4段階表示の境界を設定しま: Under “REL display thresholds”, set the target REL used as the pass criterion and the boundaries of the 4-grade display.
「目標REL %以上」を入力します。推奨周波数、表の印（·）、運用周波数計画、メ: Enter “Target REL at or above %”. It is used for the recommended frequency, the mark (·) in tables, the operating frequency plan and the judgements of the mesh, site candidates and required power.
4段階表示（EXCELLENT・GOOD・POOR・NONE）の境界を必要に応じ: Change the boundaries of the 4-grade display (EXCELLENT, GOOD, POOR, NONE) as needed.
「既定値に戻す」で境界を初期値へ戻します。: “Restore defaults” returns the boundaries to their initial values.
ヒートマップ等のセルの印（·）は目標REL以上を示し、目標RELを変えると連動し: The mark (·) in heatmap cells and elsewhere shows that the target REL is met, and it changes along with the target REL. The target REL is saved with the results as a calculation condition, so recalculate after changing it. Changes to the boundaries only affect the display.
RXが1局の場合、「24時間予測」に計算結果が表示されます。: With one RX, the results are shown under “24-hour forecast”.

The frequency row and time column of the selected cell are outlined, and the row for that frequency is also highlighted in the hourly details.
ヒートマップ上のUTCスライダーと「▶ 再生」で時刻を切り替えます。時刻別の詳細: Switch the time with the UTC slider above the heatmap and “▶ Play”. The hourly details and the link map switch to the same time.
上段に回線距離、送信地点からの方位、選択時刻の推奨周波数が表示されます。: The top row shows the link distance, the bearing from the transmit site and the recommended frequency at the selected time.
「時刻別の詳細」またはUTC選択で、REL、SNR、信号強度、打上げ角を確認しま: Check REL, SNR, signal strength and take-off angle in “Hourly details” or by selecting a UTC.
推奨周波数は目標RELを満たす入力候補から選ばれます。「基準未達」は該当候補がな: The recommended frequency is chosen from the input frequencies that meet the target REL. “Below target” means there is no such frequency.
出力欄から「報告書を印刷」（第11章）、CSV、JSON、VOACAP生出力、入: From the output area you can use “Print report” (Chapter 11) and save CSV, JSON, the raw VOACAP output and the input card.
RELは要求SNRを満たす月内の時間割合に関するモデルの回線信頼度です。瞬時の接: REL is the model’s link reliability: the fraction of time within the month that meets the required SNR. It is not the instantaneous probability of connecting. SNR is in dB·Hz (normalized to 1 Hz); do not compare it directly with the in-band SNR of a receiver.

地図右上の「REL表示」を「4段階」にすると、地図・ヒートマップ・メッシュ表がE: When “REL display” at the top right of the map is set to “4 grades”, the map, heatmaps and mesh table show the grades EXCELLENT, GOOD, POOR and NONE. The colours of the % display use the same hues as the 4-grade display, so both read with the same colours.
周波数を選んでいないとき、経路の色は選択時刻の最良RELです。段階の境界は第7章: When no frequency is selected, the path colour shows the best REL at the selected time. The grade boundaries can be changed as described in Chapter 7.
24時間予測の下に、時間帯ごとに使う周波数を決めた計画表が表示されます。計算した: Below the 24-hour forecast, a plan table shows which frequency to use in each time slot. The calculated frequencies (up to 11) are treated as the assigned frequencies, and the plan chooses among them.
時間帯、周波数、REL（最低～最高）、最低SNR、目標REL未達の時間数を確認し: Check the time slot, frequency, REL (minimum to maximum), minimum SNR and the number of hours below the target REL.
「方針」を切り替えます。「切替を抑える」（既定）は目標REL以上の時間を毎時最良: Switch the “Policy”. “Fewest switches” (default) keeps as many hours at or above the target REL as “Best each hour” and then minimizes the number of switches. “Best each hour” chooses the frequency with the highest REL at each UTC.
「CSV出力」で1時間ごとの行を保存し、「印刷」で計画表だけを印刷します。: “Export CSV” saves one row per hour, and “Print” prints only the plan table.
1日の計画を毎日繰り返す前提で、23時から0時への切替も1回と数えます。どの周波: The plan assumes the same daily plan repeats every day, so a switch from 23:00 to 0:00 also counts as one switch. In hours when no frequency reaches the target REL, the best frequency is shown and the hour is counted as “Below target REL”.

It is available in the 24-hour forecast and also in the Coverage, Propagation Chart, Diversity forecast, Mesh forecast, 12-month forecast, Required power and Site candidates tabs.
計算後、各タブの出力欄（Propagation Chartは表示欄の上）の「報告: After the calculation, press “Print report” in the output area of each tab (for the Propagation Chart, above the chart).

セルは計算した周波数とUTC時刻の離散値です。周波数間の補間はしません。MUFは: Cells are discrete values of the calculated frequencies and UTC hours. There is no interpolation between frequencies. サイト比較とサイト別詳細: Site comparison and details by site
各RXに地点、アンテナ、雑音を設定します。: Set the location, antenna and noise for each RX.
ヒートマップのセル、またはヒートマップ上のUTCスライダーと「▶ 再生」で時刻を: Select a time with a heatmap cell, or with the UTC slider above the heatmap and “▶ Play”, and check the best site for each frequency and the details by site. The selected frequency row and time column are outlined.
「目標REL以上のサイト数」を比較し、必要に応じてPropagation Cha: Compare the “Sites meeting target REL” and, if needed, switch RX in the Propagation Chart.
回線マップでは時刻スライダーに合わせて、各RXへの経路がRELで色分けされます。: On the link map, the paths to each RX are coloured by REL according to the time slider.
独立仮定の参考値が必要なときだけ、条件タブで該当チェックを有効にして再計算します: Only when you need the reference value under the independence assumption, enable the corresponding checkbox in the conditions tab and recalculate.
ダイバーシティー予測の回線マップ: Link map of the diversity forecast
ヒートマップは最良サイトのRELであり、合成後の信頼度ではありません。RELが8: The heatmap shows the REL of the best site, not a combined reliability. In an example with REL of 80% and 60%, the theoretical range for reception at at least one site is 80 to 100%, and the reference value under the independence assumption is 92%. Correlation between sites is not evaluated. Waveform combining, actual receiver switching, and availability including common failures and IP relay links are not evaluated.
2～8か所の拠点がそれぞれ送信・受信する構成について、全拠点間のRELをTX（行: For a set of 2 to 8 stations that each transmit and receive, the REL between all stations is shown as a TX (rows) × RX (columns) matrix. With N stations, N×(N−1) paths (56 paths for 8 stations) are calculated, one per direction.
右側の「送受信地点」で「メッシュ（全拠点間を両方向で計算）」を選びます。TXとR: Under “TX & RX locations” on the right, choose “Mesh (calculate all station pairs in both directions)”. The TX and RX cards change to “Station 1 to N”.
拠点ごとに地点、送信アンテナ、受信アンテナ（既定は送信と同じ）、送信電力、雑音を: For each station, set the location, transmit antenna, receive antenna (the same as the transmit antenna by default), transmit power and noise. “+ Add station” allows up to 8 stations.
「24時間の伝搬を計算」で「メッシュ予測」タブに移ります。: “Calculate 24-hour forecast →” moves to the “Mesh forecast” tab.
TX×RXマトリックス（中継で届く経路は枠と↻段数で表示）: TX × RX matrix (paths reached by relaying are outlined and show the ↻ number of relays)
UTCスライダーと「▶ 再生」でマトリックス全体の時刻を切り替えます。回線マップ: Use the UTC slider and “▶ Play” to switch the time of the whole matrix. The time of the link map follows.
「周波数」を指定するか「最良周波数」を選びます。最良周波数ではセル下段にその周波: Specify a “Frequency” or choose “Best frequency”. With the best frequency, the frequency is shown in the lower line of each cell.
「中継」を「直通のみ」「1段まで」「2段まで」（既定）から選びます。直通では目標: Choose “Relay” from “Direct only”, “Up to 1 relay” and “Up to 2 relays” (default). Paths that do not reach the target REL directly but do so by relaying are outlined and show the REL after relaying and the ↻ number of relays, with the REL without relaying below.
セルを選ぶと、下の「経路の詳細」にその経路の周波数×UTCのRELと中継経路が表: Selecting a cell shows the frequency × UTC REL and the relay route of that path in “Link detail · frequency × UTC” below. “Show reverse direction” swaps TX and RX.
メッシュ予測の回線マップ（拠点の組ごとに双方向の2本）: Link map of the mesh forecast (two paths, one in each direction, for each pair of stations)
回線マップでは、拠点の組ごとにA→BとB→Aの2本の経路を並べて描き、矢印で向き: For each pair of stations, the link map draws the two paths A→B and B→A side by side, with arrows for the direction and colours and labels for the REL of each direction.
中継は同じUTCで全区間が目標REL以上かどうかだけで判定し、区間のRELを掛け: Relaying is judged only by whether every hop meets the target REL at the same UTC; an end-to-end REL obtained by multiplying the hop RELs is not shown. Store-and-forward delay at relay stations, transmit/receive switching, interference and channel assignment are not considered. Because VOACAP inputs are asymmetric between transmission and reception, the REL of A→B and B→A may differ.
1つの経路（TX→RX1）について、予測条件の年月から12か月分の24時間予測を: For one path (TX→RX1), 24-hour forecasts are calculated for 12 months starting from the year and month in the forecast conditions, and the month × UTC REL shows the seasonal changes.
右側でTXとRXを選びます。RXが複数ある場合はRX1を使います。メッシュでは使: Choose TX and RX on the right. If there are several RX, RX1 is used. It cannot be used with the mesh.
「12か月予測」タブで「12か月を計算」を押します。エンジンを12回、逐次実行し: In the “12-month forecast” tab, press “Calculate 12 months”. The engine runs 12 times in sequence.
表の行は月、列はUTCです。「周波数」で最良周波数か特定の周波数を選びます。右端: Rows of the table are months and columns are UTC. Use “Frequency” to choose the best frequency or a specific frequency. The rightmost column is the number of hours at or above the target REL.
セルを選ぶと、下の「月の詳細」にその月の周波数×UTCを表示します。CSV/JS: Selecting a cell shows the frequency × UTC of that month in “Month detail · frequency × UTC” below. You can save CSV/JSON and print a report.
手動SSNは12か月すべてに同じ値を使います。NOAAは月ごとの平滑値を使い、新: A manual SSN uses the same value for all 12 months. NOAA uses the smoothed value for each month, and months without a fresh value are shown as grey rows. Effective SSN cannot be used.
送信電力を10 Wから10 kWまで10段階で変えて計算し、時刻・周波数ごとに目: The transmit power is varied in 10 steps from 10 W to 10 kW, and the minimum power that reaches the target REL is shown for each time and frequency.
右側でTXとRX1を選びます。右側の送信電力の値は計算に使いません（表の中で目印: Choose TX and RX1 on the right. The transmit power value on the right is not used in the calculation (it is marked in the table for reference).
「必要な送信電力」タブで「送信電力を逆算」を押します。エンジンを10回、逐次実行: In the “Required power” tab, press “Find required power”. The engine runs 10 times in sequence.
上の表で、目標REL以上になる最小の段階（W）を確認します。「>10k」は10: In the upper table, check the lowest step (W) that reaches the target REL. “>10k” means it is not reached even with 10 kW. The top row, “Minimum power”, shows the frequency and power that need the least power at that time.
下の表で、電力ごとの時刻別最良RELと目標REL以上の時間数を確認します。現在の: In the lower table, check the best REL by hour for each power level and the number of hours at or above the target REL. The row with the same power as the current setting is outlined.
電力ごとの最良REL: Best REL for each power level
段階の間の電力は計算しません。「200」は100 Wでは届かず200 Wでは届く: Powers between steps are not calculated. “200” means the target is not reached with 100 W but is reached with 200 W. The permissible power of the transmitter, power supply and radio regulations is not considered.
今のTX（中継ではRX1も）を固定したまま、登録済みの地点プリセットから、受信地: Keeping the current TX (and RX1 for relaying) fixed, compare which registered location presets reach best as a receive site or a relay site.
候補の役割と候補地点の選択: Candidate role and selecting candidate sites
「候補の役割」を選びます。受信地点（TX→候補）は候補ごとにエンジン1回、中継地: Choose the “Candidate role”. Receive site (TX→candidate) runs the engine once per candidate, and relay site (TX→candidate→RX1) twice.
地点プリセットから候補を最大10か所選びます。TXとRX1の地点、移動局は候補に: Select up to 10 candidates from the location presets. The TX and RX1 locations and mobile stations are not offered as candidates.
「候補を比較」を押すと、目標REL以上の時間数の多い順（同数なら平均RELの高い: Press “Compare candidates” to sort them by the number of hours at or above the target REL (ties by higher average REL).
各行の24マスは、その時刻の最良周波数のRELです。中継では2区間のうち低い方を: The 24 boxes in each row are the REL of the best frequency at each hour. For relaying, the lower of the two hops is shown.
候補地点ではRX1のアンテナ・雑音を使います。地形、周囲の雑音環境、設置条件の違: Candidate sites use the antenna and noise of RX1. Differences in terrain, local noise environment and installation conditions are not considered.
地点の座標・名称は「地点プリセット」に集約しています。南緯と西経は負数で入力しま: Location coordinates and names are kept together in “Location preset”. Enter southern latitudes and western longitudes as negative numbers.
地点プリセットの編集画面（一覧の先頭部分）: Location preset editing screen (top of the list)
「新規登録」で編集欄を初期化し、名称と地域を入力します。: “New preset” clears the edit fields; enter the name and region.
固定地点なら緯度・経度を入力します。予測用緯度は−89～89°です。: For a fixed location, enter the latitude and longitude. The latitude for forecasting is −89 to 89°.
「受信している移動局」を選ぶ場合は、受信局を選択して位置参照を登録します。: To choose “Received mobile station”, select the received station and register the position reference.
「保存」を押し、右側の地点選択で利用します。一覧の編集・削除で既存項目を管理しま: Press “Save” and use the location in the location selection on the right. Manage existing items with edit and delete in the list.
初期都市は概略座標です。実際の局位置を使う場合は独自の地点を登録してください。同: The initial cities are approximate coordinates. To use actual station positions, register your own locations. If simultaneous edits conflict, reload the list and edit again. Up to 200 locations can be registered.
「アンテナプリセット」でモデル、寸法、設置条件、利得補正を登録します。図は水平ダ: Register the model, dimensions, installation conditions and gain correction in “Antenna preset”. The figure shows a horizontal dipole with a total length of 20 m.
「新規登録」で名称と基準モデルを選びます。全方向（ホイップ、等方性、垂直モノポー: With “New preset”, choose the name and base model. There are omnidirectional models (whip, isotropic, vertical monopole, vertical dipole) and directional models (horizontal dipole, horizontal log-periodic, inverted L, sloping long wire, gain table).
寸法付きモデルは全長m、地上高／給電点高m、地面定数を入力します。指向性モデルは: For models with dimensions, enter the total length in m, the height above ground / feed point height in m, and the ground constants. For directional models, choose the main radiation direction from “Fixed bearing” or “Toward the other station”.
利得補正を入力し、根拠と二重計上がないことを確認して保存します。: Enter the gain correction, confirm its basis and that nothing is counted twice, and save.
右側のアンテナ選択でTXまたはRXに割り当て、再計算します。: Assign the antenna to TX or RX in the antenna selection on the right and recalculate.
利得表の登録とCSVテンプレート: Registering a gain table and the CSV template
「記入例つきテンプレート（CSV）をダウンロード」でテンプレートを保存します。: Save the template with “Download template with example values (CSV)”.
見出し frequency_mhz,azimuth_deg,elevation_: With the header frequency_mhz,azimuth_deg,elevation_deg,gain_dbi, replace the values with gains (dBi) that were measured or analysed with NEC or similar.
名称、出典・解析条件、CSVファイルを指定して「利得表を登録」を押します。: Specify the name, source / analysis conditions and the CSV file, and press “Register gain table”.
アンテナの基準モデルに「利得表」を選び、登録した利得表を割り当てて保存します。: Choose “Gain table” as the base model of the antenna, assign the registered gain table and save.
物理長、電気長、設置高を区別します。機体・艦体、整合器、SWR、ラジアル等の詳細: Distinguish physical length, electrical length and installation height. Details such as the airframe or hull, matching units, SWR and radials are not reproduced automatically. For frequencies and elevation angles outside the range of the gain table, the edge values are used. Up to 200 antennas can be registered.
宇宙天気と外部データの更新: Updating space weather and external data
「予測条件・宇宙天気」で外部データを取得します。外部提供元の値と計算に採用するS: Fetch external data under “Forecast & space weather”. Distinguish the values from external providers from the SSN used in the calculation.
外部データの取得時刻と宇宙天気（未取得の例）: Fetch times of external data and space weather (example before download)
「最新データをまとめて取得」でNOAA・国内観測等を一括更新します。個別の取得ボ: “Refresh all external data” updates NOAA, Japanese observations and other data at once. The individual fetch buttons can also be used.
観測・発行時刻と「最後に取得成功した時刻」を別々に確認します。時刻はUTCです。: Check the observation / issue time and the “last successful fetch time” separately. Times are in UTC.
提供元の更新が遅い場合、取得時刻が新しくても観測値は古いままです。失敗時は以前の: If a provider updates late, the observed values stay old even when the fetch time is new. On failure, the previous successful fetch time is kept.
NOAA平滑SSNを計算に使う場合は、SSN取得方法をNOAAへ切り替えて計算し: To use the NOAA smoothed SSN in the calculation, switch the SSN source to NOAA and calculate.
F10.7、R（電波障害）、S（太陽放射線嵐）、G（地磁気嵐）は参考表示です。追: F10.7, R (radio blackouts), S (solar radiation storms) and G (geomagnetic storms) are shown for reference only. They are not used for any additional propagation correction. The automatic NOAA SSN requires the target month to match and does not silently substitute daily values or adjacent months.
「国内観測・D-RAPを取得」で国内4観測局と吸収情報を取得します。: “Fetch Japan observations & D-RAP” fetches the four Japanese observation stations and absorption information.
地図の「D-RAP吸収」で格子を表示します。色はHAFで、回線全体の損失やMUF: “D-RAP absorption” on the map shows the grid. The colour is the HAF, not the loss of the whole link or the MUF.
NICTは参考伝搬距離を選んでLUF/MUFを確認します。観測時刻・欠測も確認し: For NICT, choose a reference propagation distance and check LUF/MUF. Also check the observation time and missing data.
GIROは条件を満たして有効化した環境で観測局を選び、「海外観測を取得」を押しま: For GIRO, in an environment where it has been enabled under its conditions, select an observation station and press “Fetch international observations”. The effective SSN is calculated from the foF2 fetched here.
GIROは既定無効です。利用条件を確認し、必要な許諾を得てから.envにHF_G: GIRO is disabled by default. Check its terms of use, obtain the necessary permission, then set HF_GIRO_ENABLED=1 in .env and restart. Observed values do not automatically correct the VOACAP REL/SNR.
ゲートウェイの準備とログイン: Preparing the gateway and logging in
外部位置の受信と本体への提供は独立ゲートウェイが担当します。通常の固定地点計算に: Receiving external positions and providing them to the main app is handled by an independent gateway. No token settings are needed for normal calculations between fixed locations. It is not available in the public version.
外部送信機→ゲートウェイ。32文字以上。: External transmitter → gateway. At least 32 characters.
本体→ゲートウェイ。32文字以上で受信用と別の値。: Main app → gateway. At least 32 characters and different from the ingest token.
Web管理へのログイン。16文字以上で両トークンと別の値。: Login to the web administration. At least 16 characters and different from both tokens.
観測時刻からの有効期限。既定300秒、10～86400秒。: Expiry from the observation time. Default 300 seconds, 10 to 86400 seconds.
プロジェクト直下の.env等で上記を設定し、docker compose up: Set the above in .env or similar directly under the project, and apply with docker compose up -d --build. Do not include secret values in Git, screen documentation or sending URLs.
http://localhost:18083 を開き、管理パスワードでログインし: Open http://localhost:18083 and log in with the administration password.
同じ端末で http://localhost:18082/api/positio: On the same machine, open http://localhost:18082/api/positions and check for a normal response with schema_version 1.
外部送信後に受信局が本体にも表示されることを確認します。: After an external transmission, check that the received station also appears in the main app.
healthyや/api/healthはDBの生存確認で、トークン認証の成功を保: healthy and /api/health only check that the DB is alive and do not guarantee successful token authentication. Between containers, position-gateway:8001 is used; this is separate from changing the published host port.
管理画面で局ごとの入力形式と受信状態を管理します。サービス用トークンをブラウザへ: The administration screen manages the input format and reception status of each station. There is no need to enter the service tokens in the browser.
管理画面の状態表示・局設定・最新位置: Status, station settings and latest positions on the administration screen
送信元sourceと局ID、局名、船舶／航空機／車両の種別を入力します。: Enter the sender source and station ID, the station name, and the type: ship, aircraft or vehicle.
形式をJSON・GeoJSON・NMEA 0183 RMCから選び、「受信有効」: Choose the format from JSON, GeoJSON and NMEA 0183 RMC, check “Input enabled” and save.
一覧の「編集」で既存局を読み込みます。形式・種別の変更や無効化は旧位置を破棄しま: Use “Edit” in the list to load an existing station. Changing the format or type, or disabling the station, discards the old position.
最新位置、観測時刻、期限切れを確認します。5秒更新は停止できます。: Check the latest position, observation time and expiry. The 5-second refresh can be stopped.
終了時はログアウトします。セッションは1時間で失効し、再起動でも無効になります。: Log out when you finish. A session expires after 1 hour and is also invalidated by a restart.
NMEA局は送信前の登録が必要です。JSON/GeoJSONは初回の有効報告で自: NMEA stations must be registered before sending. JSON/GeoJSON stations can be registered automatically by their first valid report. Use the one selected format for each station.
本体の「移動局・外部入力」で受信状況を確認し、地点プリセットからTX/RXへ割り: In “Mobile stations & input” in the main app, check the reception status and assign stations to TX/RX from the location presets.
本体の位置一覧とプロトコル設定: Position list and protocol settings in the main app
外部送信機からゲートウェイの18083番へ位置を送ります。旧本体18082番の位: External transmitters send positions to port 18083 of the gateway. Position POSTs to the former main app port 18082 have been discontinued.
「最新位置を表示」で有効位置を確認します。有効な受信局は地点プリセットに自動登録: Check valid positions with “Refresh positions”. Valid received stations are registered automatically as location presets. “Show mobile stations on map” also shows them on the map.
右側で移動局の地点プリセット（[M]付き）を選び、「最新位置に連動」の表示を確認: On the right, choose the location preset of the mobile station (marked [M]) and check that “Tracks latest position” is shown.
予測を実行します。使用した位置と観測時刻は結果へ保存されます。固定地点の選択へ戻: Run the forecast. The position and observation time used are saved with the results. Returning to a fixed location ends the tracking.
JSONの座標はlat/緯度・lon/経度、GeoJSONのcoordinate: JSON coordinates are lat/latitude and lon/longitude, and GeoJSON coordinates are in the order longitude, latitude. Times use ISO format with a time zone; for NMEA, send valid RMC sentences with a checksum.
既定300秒を超えた位置は計算に使用しません。位置は計算開始時に固定し、24時間: Positions older than the default 300 seconds are not used in calculations. The position is fixed at the start of the calculation; the 24-hour movement track and propagation corrections for aircraft altitude are not calculated.
AIとモデルおよびAPIキーの設定: Setting the AI, model and API key
「アンテナプリセット」→「カタログ・仕様書を生成AIで読み取る」→「AI・モデル: Open “Antenna preset” → “Read catalogs/specifications with AI” → “AI, model and API key settings”.
AI設定画面（モデル名は説明用サンプル）: AI settings screen (model names are illustrative samples)
使用するAIをOpenAI／ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Loca: Choose the AI to use from OpenAI/ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Local LLM.
「APIキーの取得手順」を開き、各社のAPI管理画面で発行したキーを入力します。: Open “How to obtain an API key” and enter a key issued in each provider’s API console.
「接続確認・モデル一覧を取得」を押し、画像入力・構造化出力に対応するモデルを選び: Press “Check connection / fetch models” and choose a model that supports image input and structured output. You can also enter the ID directly.
「このAI・モデルを保存して使用」を押します。AIを選択しただけではOCRへの適: Press “Save and use this AI / model”. Selecting an AI alone does not apply it to OCR.
キーの自動取得は保存設定・環境変数からの読込みです。各社からの自動発行や秘密値の: Automatic key retrieval means reading from saved settings or environment variables. Keys are not issued automatically by providers, and secret values are not recovered. Check API billing and usage limits separately from chat subscriptions such as ChatGPT. Saved keys are not stored encrypted.
取込みは候補作成です。AI読取りだけでアンテナプリセットへ自動登録しません。: Importing creates candidates. AI reading alone does not register anything as an antenna preset.
読取り候補と根拠ページ（読取値は説明用サンプル）: Read candidates and source pages (read values are illustrative samples)
資料ファイルを選びます。PDF・PNG・JPEG・WebP、1ファイル8 MiB: Choose the document file: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 8 MiB per file. A local LLM accepts images only, so PDFs are converted to page images.
必要ならHTTPSの出典URLを記録します。URLから資料を自動取得する機能では: If needed, record the HTTPS source URL. This is not a feature that fetches documents from the URL automatically.
資料の送信先とAPI料金を確認してチェックし、「生成AIで読み取る」を押します。: Check where the document is sent and the API charges, tick the checkbox and press “Read with AI”.
候補の値・単位・根拠ページを確認し、「この候補を確認・編集」を押します。: Check the candidate values, units and source pages, and press “Review and edit candidate”.
原本確認と近似使用の確認欄: Fields to confirm the source document and the approximate use
「原本をダウンロード」で対象型式の資料を開き、数値・単位・根拠ページを照合します: Open the document for the model with “Download source” and compare the values, units and source pages.
名称、基準モデル、利得補正、寸法、設置条件を修正し、原本確認にチェックします。: Correct the name, base model, gain correction, dimensions and installation conditions, and tick the source confirmation.
参考保管する場合は「参考資料のみ」を維持して保存します。計算に使う場合は適切なモ: To keep it for reference, leave “Reference only” on and save. To use it in calculations, set an appropriate model and dimensions, clear the reference flag, confirm that it is used as an approximation and save.
物理全長と電気長、地上高、dBdとdBi、送信出力と許容電力を混同しないでくださ: Do not confuse physical total length with electrical length, height above ground, dBd with dBi, or transmit output with permissible power. Do not fill unknown values with guesses; save them as reference material. Source documents and read results are stored on the server, up to 50 documents. A document cannot be deleted while a preset refers to it.
「計算履歴」で保存済みの条件と結果を再表示できます。履歴は最新100件を一覧表示: “Calculation history” shows saved conditions and results again. The history lists the latest 100 entries; the number of saved entries itself is unlimited.
「更新」で履歴一覧を取得し、対象の「開く」を押します。地点間予測・ダイバーシティ: “Refresh” fetches the history list; press “Open” for the entry you want. Point-to-point, diversity, mesh, coverage, 12-month forecast, required power and site candidate results can be shown again.
計算時点の条件と結果を確認します。移動局の当時の位置も結果に残ります。: Check the conditions and results at the time of calculation. The positions of mobile stations at that time are also kept in the results.
地点間予測の「定時の再計算に追加」で、サーバーが既定24時間ごとにNOAAの最新: With “Add to scheduled recalculation” for a point-to-point forecast, the server recalculates every 24 hours by default with NOAA’s latest smoothed SSN. The first recalculation after registration is the baseline.
目標REL以上の時間数が基準より減ると状態が「減少」になり、画面上部に通知が出ま: If the number of hours at or above the target REL falls below the baseline, the status becomes “Decreased” and a notice appears at the top of the screen. “Mark as reviewed” clears the notice; “Recalculate now” and “Delete” are also available.
入力条件とTX/RX選択を、そのブラウザへ保存。履歴やAPIキーのバックアップで: Saves the input conditions and the TX/RX selection in that browser. It is not a backup of the history or API keys.
サーバー側に計算時点の条件と結果を保存（公開版はブラウザ側）。: Saves the conditions and results at the time of calculation on the server (in the browser for the public version).
結果の持出し用。地点・アンテナ・AI設定や原本の完全バックアップではありません。: For taking results elsewhere. Not a complete backup of locations, antennas, AI settings or source documents.
設定・原本を含む保全には、停止中のhf-dataとgateway-dataを別途: To preserve everything including settings and source documents, back up hf-data and gateway-data separately while stopped.
NOAAの新鮮な値が取得できない場合は「取得失敗」とし、基準や時間数は変えません: If no fresh NOAA value can be fetched, the status is “Download failed” and the baseline and hours are not changed. Up to 20 scheduled recalculations are possible, and the interval can be changed with HF_WATCH_INTERVAL_HOURS (0 to stop). In the public version only the administrator can use this feature.
画面右上の「新機能のお知らせ」で、初期リリースからの機能追加の履歴を確認できます: With “What’s new” at the top right of the screen, you can check the history of features added since the initial release. Features added since you last opened it are marked NEW, and their number is shown on the button.
「見る」を押すと、その機能の画面へ移動します。: Press “Show” to go to the screen of that feature.
「閉じる」で一覧を閉じます。新しい機能があるときは画面上部にもお知らせが出ます。: “Close” closes the list. When there are new features, a notice also appears at the top of the screen.
表示されたエラーとログを確認し、関係する設定から切り分けます。: Check the error shown and the logs, and narrow down the cause from the related settings.
git pull --ff-only後にdocker compose confi: After git pull --ff-only, run docker compose config --quiet. If you changed the file locally, check the indentation of environment, extra_hosts and so on.
Docker起動、docker compose ps、ログ、18082番の競合を: Check that Docker is running, docker compose ps, the logs and conflicts on port 18082. If you changed the port, change the URL too.
エンジン準備が完了しない: The engine does not become ready
ビルド失敗やログを確認。ゲートウェイhealthyだけではエンジン正常性を判断し: Check for build failures and the logs. Do not judge the engine to be healthy from the gateway being healthy.
別計算の完了を待つ。保存設定の競合なら再読込みして編集し直す。: Wait for the other calculation to finish. For a conflict in saved settings, reload and edit again.
公開版で計算できない: Cannot calculate in the public version
計算回数の上限に達していないか確認。メッシュ・12か月・電力・拠点の候補は1回で: Check whether the calculation limit has been reached. Mesh, 12-month, power and site candidate calculations use several calculations at once.
ブラウザでこのページのポップアップを許可。: Allow pop-ups for this page in your browser.
移動局が計算できない: A mobile station cannot be calculated
最新位置、観測時刻、300秒の期限、局の有効状態、緯度±89°を確認。: Check the latest position, observation time, the 300-second expiry, whether the station is enabled and latitude ±89°.
本体用トークンが両サービスで一致するか、32文字以上か、受信用と別値かを確認。: Check that the main app token is the same in both services, at least 32 characters and different from the ingest token.
送信側に受信用トークンを設定。本体用トークン・管理Cookieは代用不可。: Set the ingest token on the sending side. The main app token or the administration cookie cannot be used instead.
先に同じsource/idでNMEA局を登録。RMC、チェックサム、status: Register the NMEA station with the same source/id first. Check the RMC, checksum, status and date and time.
HTTPS接続、対象年月、キャッシュの状態を確認。必要なら手動SSNへ戻す。: Check the HTTPS connection, the target year and month and the cache state. If needed, return to manual SSN.
AI・モデルの保存、キー、API利用枠、画像・構造化出力対応、ファイル8 MiB: Check that the AI and model are saved, the key, the API usage limit, support for images and structured output, and that the file is within 8 MiB.
ローカルLLMへ接続不可: Cannot connect to the local LLM
コンテナ内localhostではなくホスト接続先、待受け、ファイアウォール、AP: Check the host address (not localhost inside the container), that it is listening, the firewall and the API format.
参考アンテナを選べない: A reference antenna cannot be selected
参考資料専用です。根拠あるモデル・寸法と必要な確認が揃うまで計算不可。: It is for reference only. It cannot be used in calculations until a well-founded model and dimensions and the necessary confirmations are in place.
ログ確認：docker compose logs --tail=100 -f。問: Checking logs: docker compose logs --tail=100 -f. When asking for help, record the error, the time, the steps to reproduce and the version used, and remove API keys, tokens and confidential documents.
運用前の確認と利用条件: Checks before operation and terms of use
計算結果の利用と外部への共有に先立ち、入力条件とデータの利用条件を確認します。: Before using calculation results or sharing them externally, check the input conditions and the terms of use of the data.
TX/RXの地点・アンテナ、対象年月、SSN、電力、雑音を確認します。: Check the TX/RX locations and antennas, the year and month, SSN, power and noise.
UTCと日本時間を区別し、要求SNR・目標REL、利得と損失の重複を確認します。: Distinguish UTC from Japan time, and check the required SNR, target REL and that gains and losses are not counted twice.
移動局は受信時刻と有効期限、外部観測は観測時刻と取得成功時刻を確認します。: For mobile stations, check the reception time and expiry; for external observations, check the observation time and the successful fetch time.
変更後の再計算を行い、結果欄・報告書の条件が目的の設定と一致することを確認します: Recalculate after changes, and check that the conditions in the results and reports match the intended settings.
VOACAPは月間統計モデルです。瞬時の電離圏変動、磁気嵐、地形、実機の設置条件: VOACAP is a monthly statistical model. It does not fully reproduce instantaneous ionospheric variations, magnetic storms, terrain or actual installation conditions. Recommended frequencies, operating frequency plans and reports do not determine frequency assignments or operating permissions.
本体の新規コードはMITですが、同梱ソフトと外部データには別条件があります。GI: New code in the main app is under MIT, but the bundled software and external data have separate terms. GIRO has terms such as non-commercial research and sharing. Do not treat third-party data via NOAA or NICT data as free for unrestricted use; check the attribution and terms.
画面下の「外部データの利用条件・出典」を参照します。原本・OCR引用、移動局の位: See “External data terms & sources” at the bottom of the screen. Do not publish source documents, OCR quotations, mobile station positions, API keys or saved settings as they are. Redistribute the software by following the prescribed bundle procedure.
本体はlocalhostを前提とし個別ログインを備えていません。LAN利用時はH: The main app assumes localhost and has no individual logins. For LAN use, set HF_BIND and HF_GATEWAY_BIND separately and put the necessary authentication, HTTPS and access control in front. For publishing on the internet, use the public version setup (docs/PUBLIC_DEPLOYMENT.md).
